purpose: Describe which call-level cases the frozen within-corpus models find difficult and which human-observable cues, data-quality problems, and source/template/channel shortcuts co-occur with those cases.

case_construction.multi_tag_rule: Compute substantive membership in every stratum before deduplication. Then allocate cases in priority order: a previously selected case counts toward each lower-priority quota cell it satisfies, only enough new relation groups are added to reach that cell's quota, every case is reviewed once, and every substantive tag is retained.
case_construction.empty_cell_rule: Report an empty or undersized cell exactly; never backfill from another fold, label, direction, condition, or stratum.

tie_breaking.secret_requirement: A data steward generates a 256-bit key after protocol freeze, stores it outside public artifacts, and publishes only its SHA-256 commitment before case selection.

strata.purpose: Review every call on which at least one primary mechanism has a five-seed consensus false positive or false negative.
Characterize calls closest to the frozen AT-cross decision boundary, including difficult correct cases.
Contrast difficult cases with stable correct calls far from the AT-cross threshold.
Review stable model-decision disagreements without treating random-pair behavior as proof of utterance-specific alignment.
Provide non-cherry-picked correctly classified comparison calls.

annotation_codebook.missing_metadata_rule: retain_unknown_or_not_available; never infer global speaker identity, missing taxonomy, source, topic, ASR quality, or channel from filenames or class label
annotation_codebook.free_text_rule: No verbatim quotations and no names, phone numbers, account numbers, addresses, identity numbers, unique organizations, URLs, or other identifying details. Use controlled tags and non-identifying paraphrase.

privacy_and_governance.audio_redaction_rule: If audio review is chosen, every transcript redaction span must be time-aligned and masked in audio with conservative padding; unverified audio must not enter a reviewer packet.
privacy_and_governance.packet_metadata_rule: strip filenames, paths, embedded metadata, source tags, labels, folds, and model fields
privacy_and_governance.privacy_incident_rule: reviewer_marks_possible_identifier_exposure; stop access to that case, quarantine it, repair redaction, version the packet, and record the incident without publishing content
privacy_and_governance.public_release_rule: release_only_aggregate_counts_and_non_identifying_paraphrases; never release raw audio, verbatim transcript, case-to-call mapping, call IDs, relation-group IDs, reviewer names, or case-level model outputs

post_unblind_merge.capacity_overlay: Join capacity condition signatures only for already selected cases; do not add capacity-only cases and do not alter sampling tags.

analysis_rules.uncertainty: Relation-group clustered descriptive bootstrap intervals are permitted only for exhaustive-error or probability-sampled estimands with a meaningful denominator; deterministic near-threshold, high-confidence, and flip strata receive counts and proportions without population confidence intervals.

stop_rules: Stop before case selection unless the protocol is separately approved and frozen with all readiness blockers resolved.
Stop if an evidence hash differs from the approved frozen binding.
Stop if a call maps to multiple outer folds, lacks five seed records for a required condition, has inconsistent labels or relation groups, or uses an unsealed threshold.
Stop if reviewer packets expose any hidden field or unredacted identifier.
Stop and version the packet after any privacy incident; do not silently replace reviewed content.
Stop reconciliation until every intended independent form is locked or explicitly documented missing.
Stop post-unblind analysis if the private case mapping, roster commitment, draw-key commitment, annotation files, or packet manifest fails integrity verification.

unresolved_pi_decisions.question: Who are the authorized Korean-fluent reviewers and the separate packet/redaction steward?
unresolved_pi_decisions.required_choice: Confirm at least two reviewers, confirm Korean fluency, identify whether at least one is independent of model development, and confirm a steward who will not annotate the packets they prepare.

unresolved_pi_decisions.question: What documented authorization permits these reviewers to access redacted call content?
unresolved_pi_decisions.required_choice: Record lawful/permitted research use for both sources, IRB approval or exemption/not-applicable determination, restricted-access location, and retention/deletion plan before any packet is created.

unresolved_pi_decisions.question: Will reviewers receive redacted audio plus redacted transcript, or redacted transcript only?
unresolved_pi_decisions.required_choice: Choose redacted_audio_and_redacted_transcript to assess ASR correctness and audible channel artifacts, or redacted_transcript_only and accept that those fields are not assessable.

freeze_readiness_checklist: All three PI decisions are resolved in a new protocol candidate.
Reviewer private roster commitment and stewardship separation are recorded.
Governance authorization and restricted review environment are documented.
Review mode and its assessability limits are fixed.
Annotation codebook and both JSON schemas pass validation.
A private 256-bit HMAC key is generated and only its SHA-256 commitment enters the frozen protocol.
A no-outcome dry run on synthetic ledgers proves seed collapse, group-first quotas, multi-tag deduplication, empty-cell handling, and hidden-field exclusion.
An independent reviewer verifies evidence bindings by hash without opening named cases or transcripts.
The final protocol candidate is assigned a new immutable path, status, SHA-256, and read-only permissions before any real case selection.
Only after the freeze receipt passes may a separate outcome-access command construct the restricted case map and reviewer packets.
